reflexium.title: Reflexium
reflexium.option.reflex_mode.tooltip: Reduces input latency by starting each frame just in time for the GPU. On + Boost also keeps GPU clocks high when CPU-bound.
reflexium.option.dlss_detection.tooltip: Enables Vulkan device extensions required for DLSS upscaling. Requires restarting the game to take effect.
reflexium.option.upscaler.tooltip: Renders the world at a lower resolution and upscales it to display resolution. FSR works on any GPU, DLSS needs an NVIDIA RTX GPU. Auto uses DLSS when available, otherwise FSR.
reflexium.option.quality.tooltip: Controls the internal render resolution used for upscaling. Native AA keeps full resolution with temporal anti-aliasing, while other presets lower resolution to improve performance.
reflexium.option.dlss_model.tooltip: Selects the neural network model used for DLSS upscaling. Transformer is sharper, CNN is lighter on older RTX cards, and Auto lets the driver pick.
reflexium.option.fsr_sharpness.tooltip: Applies an additional sharpening filter after FSR upscaling. Set to 0% to disable sharpening.
reflexium.option.status.tooltip: Shows real-time status and diagnostics for Reflex, upscalers, and shaders.
modmenu.descriptionTranslation.reflexium: NVIDIA Reflex, DLSS and AMD FSR 3.1 for Minecraft's Vulkan renderer.
